title: precheck warns when a sprint's goal research story still holds the generated goal
goal: backlog.py precheck SP prints a warning when the sprint's goal research story still holds the goal new sprint generated (bl_land.RESEARCH_DEFAULT_GOAL), so the planner narrows it to the sprint's questions or records why there are none before the start gate. SP-ccvfvoqj: ST-yom2npf4 kept the default goal, researched read no question, and the story passed on its no-outside-facts note alone.
